title: Data and Persistence Basics
learning_objectives: Explain the difference between in-memory data and persisted data
Store and retrieve data using a simple persistence mechanism (file or lightweight database)
Extend a simple API to read and write data
Describe basic error cases when reading or writing data
outline: Simple persistence options (file or lightweight database)
Reading data to serve via an API endpoint
Writing data from a client into storage

format: API that can read and write simple records
Demonstrated request/response examples that show persisted changes

constraints_for_professor: Use the simplest viable persistence option for the environment
Avoid schema design and complex relational modeling
